name: PairDrop
description: Local file sharing in the browser, AirDrop-style: devices on the same network see each other on the page and send files directly, peer to peer. The server only introduces them; it never holds a file.

access.note: PairDrop has no accounts: anyone who opens the address joins the room of devices behind the same public address, and rooms beyond that need a pairing code or a shared link that the page generates. Files travel browser to browser and never through this server. The dashboard's proxy sends the visitor's address along, which is how PairDrop groups devices.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open; nothing else here changes when it does.

update.notes: Stateless: nothing is stored on the server, so there is nothing to migrate.
